findings.detail: The AUD marker belongs to the Par/Shares field for the Sonar Acquisitionco row; cost is in the separate Cost column and should remain USD-denominated.

rationale: FX03 is a Class 1 single-cell check of cost_currency. The raw SOI row places AUD inside the Par/Shares group, while Cost and Fair Value are separate columns; footnote (4) defines AUD/EUR as exceptions for par amount denomination. The pipeline observed cost_currency as U_AUD, so it appears to have propagated the par currency marker into cost_currency. The source therefore grounds a real localized data error, not a false alarm.
